rawContent: Educational institutions in particular, including @cityofhope,  must implement concrete, visible plans to combat institutional racism and oppression in our own houses ASAP. To cite @wkamaubell, it's not enough just to do the work. We also have to SHOW the work. #BLM #showyourwork

I will show up for and amplify URM colleagues at talks, symposia, etc.(goal: 5x⬆️ attendance). I will call out aggressions & hold space no matter how uncomfortable it gets (hard to milestone, goal is💯). Posting here so y'all hold me to account. #BLM #RepresentationMatters /end
